parsed.rationale: I don't think this is an anterior MI: the trace shows sinus rhythm with narrow QRS complexes, a normal PR interval and R waves building normally across V1–V4, with no pathological Q waves; V2–V4 have upsloping ST segments with J points near baseline and upright, proportionate T waves, which fits a normal early-repolarization pattern rather than STEMI-level elevation, and the limb leads only show baseline noise.
